speaker: Sheldon
text: Godzilla claws? Rats. I've got it! I finally reconciled the black hole information paradox with my theory of string network condensates.

speaker: Ramona
text: You know you need your sleep in order for your cognitive processing to perform at optimal levels. Now come on. It's unbelievable. It's paradigm altering.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And I could not have done it without you.

speaker: Ramona
text: Please, I just offered a little encouragement.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, it was a lot more than that. You helped me work out the masses of all the fermions, and you pummeled my hammer toe. How can I ever repay you?

speaker: Ramona
text: Well, would you consider naming it the Cooper Nowitzki theorem?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Who's Nowitzki?

speaker: Ramona
text: I'm Nowitzki.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, you want me to share credit? Get out.

speaker: Ramona
text: Uh-huh.

speaker: Kathy O'Brien
text: Excuse me, Dr. Cooper. I'm Kathy O'Brien. I just finished reading your paper reconciling the black hole information paradox with your theory of string network condensates, and it just took my breath away. Would you possibly have any time for me to pick your brain?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Maybe when I publish it, I'll include an inhaler.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Let's see, today's Thursday. Thursday nights I eat pizza from Giacomo's. Sausage, mushrooms, light olives.

speaker: Kathy O'Brien
text: Great. I'll bring it to your place. I have the address.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What a nice girl.

speaker: Leonard
text: Not unless she destroys Tokyo. Sheldon, do you see what just happened here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yes. I'm getting a free pizza. I'm on a roll. More pad thai, please.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, you've already had four servings.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You might want to slow down a bit, buddy. Just one more bite.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon? Sheldon, are you okay?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm just so full.

speaker: Leonard
text: That's it. No more Thai food.
